description: Agent5Q is designed to ingest file-based data such as audio MP3s for transcription and Boggle grids for word validation. It can browse web-sourced dictionaries, execute Python code for puzzle solving, and process audio for extracting information. The agent filters and validates data against specific dictionaries and outputs results in a strictly formatted manner.

tools.name: FileIO
tools.description: Handles file input/output operations, allowing the agent to read and write data from local files.

tools.name: WebBrowser
tools.description: Enables the agent to browse the web and retrieve data from online sources, such as dictionaries or text files.

tools.name: PythonExecutor
tools.description: Executes Python code for tasks such as solving puzzles or processing data.

tools.name: SpeechToText
tools.description: Converts audio input into text format for further processing and analysis.

tools.name: DictionaryValidator
tools.description: Validates words against specified dictionaries to ensure accuracy and adherence to rules (e.g., excluding proper nouns).
